meta.title: Made-to-measure furniture configurator | PoMerka
meta.description: Design furniture to your own measurements: live 3D view, cut list, sheet layouts and price.

home.title: What are we building?
home.subtitle: Every model is a starting point: the measurements, elements and decors are yours. The cut list follows every change.

desc.sideboard: Hung on the wall, with doors, drawers or open elements.
desc.openSideboard: Hung on the wall, without doors: shelves only.
desc.standingSideboard: Stands on legs, with doors, drawers or open elements.
desc.drawerSideboard: Drawers in every element, on legs or hung on the wall.
desc.wardrobe: Tall columns with doors, shelves and hanging rails.
desc.nightstand: Small, with drawers or an open shelf, on legs or on the wall.
desc.wallCabinet: Shallow cabinet for the wall with one or two doors.

save.title: Saved designs
save.help: Designs are stored in this browser. To move one to another device, use Copy link.
save.name: Name of the design
save.empty: Nothing saved for this model yet.

notices.shelvesReduced: The new height fits at most {max, plural, =0 {no shelves} one {# shelf} other {# shelves}} per element, so shelves were reduced.
notices.drawersReduced: The new height fits at most {max, plural, one {# drawer} other {# drawers}} per element, so drawers were reduced.
notices.doubleDoorsRemoved: Elements narrower than {min} were changed to a single door.
notices.restoredDefaults: That link could not be opened, so the default design is shown.
notices.railRemoved: A hanging rail no longer fits, so it was removed.

field.stepHint: 1 mm per click; hold Shift for 10 mm

issues.sheetLimit: The top is cut from one board, so the width cannot exceed {max}. For a wider piece, place two side by side.
issues.widthForElements: With {count, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}} the width must be between {min} and {max}. Remove an element to go narrower.
issues.elementMin: Each element must be at least {min} wide, so this one can be between {min} and {max}.
issues.elementCount: This width fits between {min} and {max} elements.
issues.shelvesMax: At this height an element fits at most {max, plural, =0 {no shelves} one {# shelf} other {# shelves}} (shelves need {spacing} between them).
issues.drawersMax: At this height an element fits at most {max, plural, one {# drawer} other {# drawers}} (each front needs {min}).
issues.doubleDoorMin: Double doors need an element at least {min} wide.
issues.drawersDepth: Drawers need a depth between {min} and {max}.
issues.elementMax: An element can be at most {max} wide. Add an element or reduce the width.
issues.railSpace: A hanging rail needs a height of at least {height} and a depth of at least {depth}.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.help: Outer measurements. Depth is the total depth, including the back panel and the doors or drawer fronts.

elements.title: Elements
elements.help: How many compartments the piece has and how wide each one is. The widths always add up to the total width.
elements.maxNote: This width fits up to {max, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}}; each must be at least {min} wide.

fronts.title: Fronts and shelves
fronts.help: For each element: doors, drawers or open, and the number of shelves.
fronts.summary: {closed} of {total, plural, one {# element} other {# elements}} closed
fronts.maxShelves: At this height each element fits up to {max, plural, =0 {no shelves} one {# shelf} other {# shelves}}, at least {spacing} apart.
fronts.drawersUnavailable: Drawers need a total depth of at least {min}. Increase the depth to enable them.
fronts.doubleUnavailable: Double doors need an element at least {min} wide.
fronts.drawerFront: Front height about {value}; up to {max} drawers fit this height.
fronts.railHelp: A rail for hangers with {space} of clear hanging height under it; shelves go above the rail.
fronts.railUnavailable: A hanging rail needs a height of at least {height} and a depth of at least {depth}.

colours.title: Colours
colours.help: Choose the decor of the body and of the fronts separately.
colours.disclaimer: Colours on screen are indicative. Check the real decor on a sample before ordering.

details.title: Details
details.help: Back panel, top and how the fronts open.
details.backHelp: Closes the back of the body and adds a 3 mm HDF panel per element to the cut list.
details.doubleTopHelp: The top is two boards glued together. The total height stays the same; the body below is one board lower.
details.handlesHelp: Fronts are opened with a handle.
details.pushHelp: Fronts open with a light push; no handles.

shapes.longBar: Tall bar, half the door height

details.legHelp: The total height stays the same; the body is lower by the height of the legs.

summary.intro: This is what goes into the cut list.
summary.elementLine: Element {n}: {width}, {front}{shelves, plural, =0 {} one {, # shelf} other {, # shelves}}

items.hangingRail: Hanging rail, cut to the element

results.title: Results

parts.lengthNote: Length runs along the grain of the decor. Sizes are the finished sizes of the parts.
parts.bandLong: {count, plural, one {one long edge} other {both long edges}}
parts.bandShort: {count, plural, one {one short edge} other {both short edges}}
parts.noteHinges: {count} hinge holes Ø35 on the hinge edge

sheets.note: Guillotine layouts: every cut runs edge to edge. Saw kerf {kerf}, {trim} trimmed from each sheet edge. Numbers match the cut list.
sheets.stock: {name} — {count, plural, one {# sheet} other {# sheets}} of {size} mm
sheets.grain: Grain runs along the sheet length (arrow); these parts are not rotated.
sheets.caption: Sheet {n}: {used} used, {parts, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}
sheets.aria: Layout of sheet {n} with {parts, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}

price.waste: Of the board cost, about {used} ends up in the piece and {waste} is offcuts. Whole sheets are charged.
price.ownHelp: Checked prices with a workshop? Enter them and recalculate.
price.disclaimer: Indicative price in Macedonian denars. Delivery and assembly are not included. The final price is confirmed by the workshop.

hardware.note: Quantities follow the parts list. Screws, caps, nails and plugs include a 10 % reserve.
